claim: The iPhone 12 won’t come with earphones and a charging adapter.
justification: High-confidence evidence from both fact-checks consistently indicates that Apple officially announced the iPhone 12 would not include earphones (EarPods) or a charging adapter in the box, citing environmental reasons, with the announcement made on October 13, 2020. Low-confidence evidence suggesting inclusion of these accessories is marked as contradicted and likely fabricated, so it is discounted. Therefore, the claim is strongly supported by trustworthy knowledge.
